title: QBR Rapid Ops Playbook & Stakeholder Commitment Matrix
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Purpose: Produce a compact, action-oriented packet for the upcoming QBR that lets execs make tradeoff decisions in 15 minutes. This ticket owns the 'Rapid Ops Playbook' content (decision rails, escalation lanes, and a stakeholder commitment matrix) and a single-slide action matrix for each major initiative. Scope: - One-pager per initiative with 3 decision options (accelerate / maintain / de-prioritize) and estimated resource delta - Risk thermometers tied to current sprint metrics (latency, cost per 1M tokens, SLO breach probability) - Clear escalation path (who signs off on re-allocation, which Dedicated pools are eligible for burst) Audience: CEO, CRO, Head of Infra, and the Platform Investment Committee. Primary ask: a binary approval (Go / Hold) and a committed owner for any 'accelerate' decisions. Deliverables: 1) Master decision matrix (CSV + Google Sheets) 2) One-slide initiative packets (PDF) 3) Exec one-pager summarizing asks and tradeoffs 4) Suggested micro-actions (owner + 30/60/90 day milestones)
